using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using KingZon.OLCM.Production.Shared.DataBase.Entities;

// Only missing host types are doubles. Planning entities and mappings are real source.
namespace KingZon.Core.DataBase
{
    public class BaseEntity { public long Id { get; set; } }
    public interface ISoftDeletedEntity { bool IsDeleted { get; set; } }
    public abstract class KingZonEntityTypeConfiguration<T> : IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> where T : class
    {
        public abstract void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<T> builder);
    }
}
namespace KingZon.OLCM.Base.Shared.DataBase.Entities
{
    public class Base_Product { public long Id { get; set; } }
    public class Base_ProductSpecification { public long Id { get; set; } }
    public class Base_Unit { public long Id { get; set; } }
    public class Base_UnitConversion { public long Id { get; set; } }
    public class Base_Department { public int Id { get; set; } }
    public class Base_Partner { public long Id { get; set; } }
    public class Base_Craft { public long Id { get; set; } }
    public class Base_Machine { public long Id { get; set; } }
    public class Base_User { public int Id { get; set; } }
}
namespace KingZon.OLCM.Base.Shared.DataBase.Enum
{
    public enum InventoryDataType { Product=1, Specification=2 }
    public enum InventoryDataStatus { None=0 }
}
namespace KingZon.OLCM.Base.DataBase.Enum { public enum OperateType { 接单=1, 出单=2 } }
namespace KingZon.OLCM.Production.Shared.DataBase.Enum
{
    // Host NodeType/NodeState numeric definitions are intentionally not introduced into production source.
    public enum NodeType { 测试=1 }
    public enum NodeState { 测试=1 }
    public enum MaterialDemandType { 领料需求=1, 补料需求=2 }
}
namespace KingZon.OLCM.Production.Shared.DataBase.Entities
{
    public class Production_Dispatch_Order { public long Id { get; set; } }
}
public class PlanningDb(DbContextOptions<PlanningDb> options) : DbContext(options)
{
    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder model)
    {
        model.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof(Production_Plan).Assembly);
        model.Entity<Production_Dispatch_Order>().HasKey(x=>x.Id);
    }
}
